title: S-Pod Kit Bundle
description:
S-Type vape devices are compatible with the widest array of pre-filled pods in Canada. This Bundle packages together the ALLO SYNC Starter Kit with pods by Flavour Beast and G-Blast. While there are other brands that will work with this kit, these 3 have the most overlap – meaning if you like ALLO SYNC you are more likely to enjoy Flavour Beast or G-Blast than STLTH or CLX pods. All included pods are 20mg and 2ml.

Summer 2024 S-Type Bundle

- ALLO SYNC Kit (comes with device, 1 x Frost 2ml, 1 x Pineapple Ice 2ml, 1 x Blue Raspberry 2ml)

- 1 x Flavour Beast Pods Mad Mango Peach Pack (3 x 2ml)

- 1 x G-Blast Pod Route Pack (3 x 2ml)

- Savings of $8.00

This bundle provides a sampling of top sellers by each brand and includes both iced and un-iced flavours. ALLO, Flavour Beast and Gcore (G-Blast) each offer flavours in Disposables, Pods and e-Liquids. Only available for online purchase.
